mode.label: Builder
mode.abHint: Change one agent setting and test it against the baseline.

sections.agentsHint: One agent compares models; several compare agents.
sections.modelsHint: Leave empty to use each agent's own model.

fields.name: Experiment name
fields.allowUnpriced: Allow models without a price (cost per success will be unknown)
fields.adaptiveHint: Stop a task early once every setup agrees on it. Tries becomes the maximum.
fields.probesHint: The normal run always happens. Each failure test runs the same tasks again.
fields.tokenHint: Local mode: plan, estimate and run are writes. The token stays in this tab.
fields.notReadyTitle: Run its readiness check on the benchmark page first.

preview.title: Matrix preview
preview.description: Setup A is the baseline for the verdict.
preview.runs: up to {{runs}} runs ({{arms}} setups x {{conditions}} tests x {{tasks}} tasks x {{trials}} tries)
preview.empty: Pick at least one agent and fill in a model to see the setups.

actions.needsToken: Enter the write token to estimate, plan and run.
actions.needsPlan: Plan the experiment first: the plan checks it and shows its power.
actions.planStale: The form changed after planning. Plan again before running.
actions.blocked: The plan has errors. Fix them and plan again.
actions.startError: Experiment {{id}} was created but did not start. Use Start on its page to try again.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.costNoHistory: Not known yet: nothing like this has run on this benchmark, so there is no history to estimate from.
estimate.budgetCap: The budget of {{budget}} stops the comparison when it is spent.
estimate.priceRefNoHistory: Model prices come from {{ref}}. They are used once there is history to price.
estimate.timeLimitBound: at most {{high}} (from each agent's time limit)

plan.timeCostPress: Time and cost: press Estimate cost.
plan.timeCostSee: Time and cost: see the Estimate.

link.agentMissing: Agent {{id}} is not one of your agents, so the comparison starts with {{first}}.

ready.pending: Checking which tasks are ready. The benchmark and task count update when that is known.

errors.modelEmpty: Type a model name, or pick a second agent.
errors.tooFewArms: A comparison needs at least 2 setups: add a model or an agent.
errors.tooManyArms: At most 26 setups: remove some agents or models.
errors.taskCountRange: Pick between 1 and the number of tasks in the benchmark.
errors.trialsRange: Trials must be a whole number from 1 to 50.
errors.adaptiveTrials: Adaptive trials need at least 2 trials per task.
errors.adaptiveMin: Minimum must be at least 1 and below the trials.
errors.seedInt: The seed is a whole number, 0 or more.

steps.whatHint: Pick a benchmark and give the comparison a name.
steps.whoHint: Every agent runs with every model.
steps.sizeHint: Tasks, trials and the most it may spend.
steps.extrasHint: Failure tests, adaptive tries, concurrency, seed and pool.
